state.name: Audio Transcription — Open
state.purpose: Read a transcription already saved on an audio attachment. Copy it, or append it to the task description. This sheet does not start, wait for, or retry speech-to-text.

append.emptyDescription: use the transcript as the description, with no leading break

createAndEdit.onLaterOpenThisVisit: Added to description replaces Add to Description and stays disabled. Copy stays available.

notPresentedHere.transcribing: Shown on the audio attachment card. Transcribe with AI does not open this sheet.
notPresentedHere.transcriptionError: Shown on the audio attachment card, with Retry. This sheet has no error state.

empty.when: speech-to-text returned 200 and the transcript is empty

visualRules: Use the global bottomSheet pattern from design-system.json, including its drag handle.
Do not define sheet-specific colors, radii or spacing.
There is no approved reference PNG yet. Do not measure tokens from a conceptual mockup.
The transcript is read-only text, not a textarea and not the description editor.
auto_awesome marks the sheet title only. Do not add a glow, gradient, decorative waveform or extra sparkle.
Copy is a secondary action. Add to Description is the primary action until it has succeeded.
Added to description uses the disabled secondary treatment. Copy stays available.
Teal is reserved for the primary action. Danger is not used on this sheet.
Processing and failure stay on the audio attachment card. Do not add those states to this sheet.
A 200 response with no transcript opens this sheet with No text in this recording. Copy and Add to Description stay hidden. The empty text is not stored on the attachment.
Closing the sheet does not delete the transcription, remove the audio, or undo an append that already happened.

reference.description: Draft until an approved PNG is added. Do not point this spec at a missing reference image.

angular.note: Shared by Create Task, Edit Task and Task View. Opens only after a transcription is already stored on the attachment. Reuse SpeechToTextService for the earlier card action; opening this sheet must not call POST /api/ai/speech-to-text. The response is a transcript string with no progress percent.
